title: Changelog
use: a platform update worth announcing — the version tag up top, the headline of the release, and the updates that matter, one per line

eyebrow.label: the version tag, e.g. UPDATE 0.1.18 or THIS WEEK IN NEUMA

headline.label: the release's own headline — what this update IS, not a list of it. 24, the same budget stat and explainer carry: it is the same slot at the same size on the same frame

updateOne.label: first update — one plain sentence, the most important change first

updateThree.label: third update — with only three changes, write a shorter fourth honestly (e.g. — more landing next week)

footer.label: where the full record lives, in words — e.g. FULL CHANGELOG IN THE RELEASE NOTES (the post's text carries the link). 46, not 64: the line rose to the 34px family floor and mono at 34 only holds 47 characters inside the 1344px frame, measured
